params.body:
Fixes bevinding garagebeheer-open-voor-dealers-en-traders.

## What was open

The `access` middleware only asks the role table, and `DealerController` checked nothing itself. On production (30 September 2026) the role table gives the menu `dealer` (menu 8, under Beheer) to role 5 "Dealers en Traders" (about 284 users) with view and edit, and to role 6 with view and edit. With that:

- `/dealers` (`dealer.index`) listed every garage with name, email, phone and module switches; `dealer.index.export` exported them.
- `dealer.edit` opened any garage's sheet by id, and so did `ownuser.edit` (the own sheet had an ownership check on update only).
- `dealer.update.updateModule` switched module 1 and module 2 of any garage on the edit right alone.
- `dealer.update` had an ownership check only on the `ownuser.update` route; through `dealer.update` a role 5 user could update another garage.
- Portal add/remove, `create`/`store` and `destroy` had no check beyond the role table.

Page views since 25 September 2026 show no non-administrator on `dealer.index` or `dealer.edit`; nothing is known about the time before.

## The fix

Two private guards in `DealerController`, called first in each action (before any try/catch):

- `authorizeGarageAdministration()`: administrators only, 403 otherwise, for `index` (`/dealers` and `/users`), `export`, `create`, `store`, `destroy`, `update_module`, `addPortal`, `destroyPortal`.
- `authorizeGarage($id)`: for `edit` and `update`. On `dealer.*` the administrator for any garage, anyone else only for the own garage. On the own sheet (`ownuser.edit`, `ownuser.update`) only the own garage, for everyone, as `ownuser.update` already did.

The own garage sheet ("Mijn garage", `?tab=2` for Werknemers, the link from "Mijn profiel") uses `ownuser.edit` / `ownuser.update` with the own dealer id, and keeps working. The paid module flags and the demo flag are now stripped from a sheet update for every non-administrator on either route, not only on `ownuser.update`, since a garage user can now reach `dealer.update` for the own garage.

`/users` (`user.index`) routes to the same garage list. Roles 3, 4 and 5 have no view right on the menu `user`; role 6 has full rights on it, and nothing in the code says what role 6 uses the list for. So `/users` stays readable for role 6 (new constant `Role::VERTEGENWOORDIGER`), and everything else of garage administration is 403 for that role too. Dropping role 6 from `/users` is one line once it is clear nobody in that role relies on it.

The export and "+ Toevoegen" buttons on the list now show for administrators only, instead of for whoever has the add right.

`dealer.index.image` and `dealer.index.background_image` (the garage logos on every page) are not in `DealerController` and stay open. `role_access` data is not changed here; the code guard is the fix, the rights clean-up comes separately.

## Tests

`GarageAdministrationIsForAdministratorsTest`: every user carries full rights on the menus `dealer`, `user` and `ownuser` in the session, so what turns the garage user away has to be the controller. A role 5 user gets 403 on `/dealers`, `/users`, the export, create/store/destroy, another garage's `dealer.edit`, `ownuser.edit` and `dealer.update`, `update_module` on another garage, and portal add/remove; the same user still opens and updates the own garage sheet, and can use `dealer.edit`/`dealer.update` for the own garage without setting module flags; the administrator keeps everything; role 6 keeps `/users` and nothing else; the logo routes answer for role 4 and role 5 users. 8 of the 11 tests fail on main; the 3 that pass on main pin what must keep working (own sheet, administrator, logos).

`ListPageHeadersTest` and `ListFilterSessionTest` opened `/dealers` as a non-administrator to check the toolbar and the filter session; they now open it as an administrator.

Business rules: new R P2-1.11, R P2-1.8 updated (export is the administrator's), finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-30-garagebeheer-open-voor-dealers-en-traders.md`.

Checked locally: full PHPUnit suite, PHPStan, Pint on the new test.
params.title: Garage administration screens are for administrators
